name: @flagbearer/web
description: Feature flags for the browser and React: gradual rollouts and live updates, from Flagbearer.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target browser --format esm --outdir ./dist --define __FLAGBEARER_SDK_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p type-tests/typed && tsc --noEmit -p type-tests/untyped
